internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: The company has always operated from its premises located at the Ta’ Qali Crafts Village, including a workshop and four retail shops. We welcome thousands of tourists each year to our retail shops, where they can assist in a free-of-charge live glass blowing demonstration — where we produce custom-designed glassware to exceptional standards.
